written: 2026-10-09, owner decision of the same day (two weeks), before the first run of any 14.3 study registered after it
question: How long may BIG 14.3 (diagnose, quantify and admit evidence) spend on flagship A before it must close?
covers: every 14.3 study of flagship A registered on or after 2026-10-09, first big14-a-kirkaldy-fade; the studies already run and recorded before this date keep their outcomes unchanged
at_the_end: if admissible independent data or a required provider environment is not available, or a registered study has not run, the campaign closes as a justified refusal that names the missing evidence and the next admissible step; the timebox is not extended by a later decision recorded as if it were this one
